👍 Like,  ❤️ Favorite and ⭐️ Support for more quality Updates!

Welcome to 🚄 Train Simulator 🚉 !
Experience the thrill of high-speed rail 🛤️ with realistic passenger trains on a beautifully crafted Hamburg and surrounding map 🗺️. Pick up passengers, unlock new trains 🚄, and expand routes 🚉 as you go! Join the railway adventure today and bring the railway to life✨!

💥 New Train: Take control of the powerful ICE Train 🚅 with a top speed of 250 km/h! 💥

📱 Mobile Friendly: Navigate with a joystick 🕹️ for speed control simple GUI buttons for operating doors 🚪. 

🎖️ Private Servers: Enjoy a 2x Passenger Booster 🚀 in private servers!

⚙️ Update Log:
+ ICE Train 🚅
+ lag-free Trains🛜
+ more Scenery🗺️
+ fixed Bugs🛠

We reached over 3.00.000 Visits! Can we hit 5.000.000?
Thanks for all the support ❤️!
